explanation: Zero at every D1 and GO step, and zero at any D2 except one where the agent chose a2 and commonly reached S2; such a D2 scores 9-10 late in the episode (trial ~85-99) when the previous trial was rewarded, about 2-5 when it was unrewarded (0 after several unrewarded in a row), only 1-3 around trials 60-75, and 0 before trial ~60. Rare transitions and any a1 choice always give 0.
